objectives: Complete a short diagnostic task independently.
Set a personal TypingClub target for the term.
Explain what this term's theme covers: documents and photos.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: Sign in, posture check, free practice.

plan.title: Term reveal
plan.detail: Theme: 'Documents & Photos'. Show the Week 15 exemplar fact-file. Explain: by December you will take your own photos and put them in a properly structured document.

plan.title: Diagnostic
plan.detail: Log in, open Docs, type a sentence about the holidays, save with the correct name. Record on the diagnostic checklist who is secure, nearly there, or needs support.

plan.title: Set targets
plan.detail: Review last year's TypingClub level. Write a target on the goal sheet: a level, a WPM or an accuracy percentage.

plan.title: Plenary
plan.detail: Pair share: one skill you already have, one you want this term. Log out.

successCriteria: I completed the diagnostic without step-by-step help.
My target is written on the goal sheet.
I can say what this term is about.

objectives: Reach the top row and bottom row while keeping fingers anchored on the home row.
Type without looking at my hands for a whole exercise.
Record my accuracy honestly.

plan.title: Home-row anchor drill
plan.detail: 60 seconds on ASDF JKL only, then reach for E and C without moving the anchor fingers.

plan.title: Reach and return
plan.detail: Model the reach-and-return motion on the visualiser. The finger goes up and comes straight back - it does not stay there.

plan.title: TypingClub units
plan.detail: Independent unit work on top and bottom rows. Posture freeze every 5 minutes.

plan.title: No-peek challenge
plan.detail: One exercise with a card covering the hands. Accuracy will drop - that is expected and fine.

plan.title: Chart and reflect
plan.detail: Update the accuracy chart. Which row is hardest? Log out.

successCriteria: My anchor fingers stay on the home row.
I completed a whole exercise without looking down.
I recorded my real accuracy on the chart.

objectives: Apply Heading 1 and Heading 2 styles instead of just making text big.
Create a bulleted list and a numbered list.
Explain when to use a numbered list rather than bullets.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Styles vs big bold text
plan.detail: Show two documents that look identical. Change the theme - only the styled one updates. Rule: use the Styles panel, not manual formatting.

plan.title: Apply headings
plan.detail: Open the practice text. Apply Heading 1 to the title and Heading 2 to each section. Do it in both Word and Docs.

plan.title: Two kinds of list
plan.detail: Bullets for things in any order (ingredients), numbers for steps in order (a recipe). Pupils make one of each in their document.

plan.title: Sort it out
plan.detail: Quickfire: bullets or numbers? Shopping list, fire drill steps, favourite films, how to log in. Save and log out.

activities: Apply H1 and H2 to practice text
successCriteria: My document uses real heading styles.
I made one bulleted and one numbered list.
I can explain when to use each type of list.

objectives: Frame a photo using the rule of thirds.
Face the light so my subject is not dark.
Tap to focus before taking the shot.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Three rules of a good photo
plan.detail: Framing (thirds, not dead centre), light (light behind the photographer), focus (tap the subject). Show a good and a bad example of each.

plan.title: Device rules
plan.detail: Handling rules for school tablets: two hands, wrist strap, no photos of people without asking. This is a safeguarding point - be explicit.

plan.title: Photo walk
plan.detail: In pairs, take three photos of one chosen classroom object: one badly lit, one centred, one following all three rules. Comparison is the lesson.

plan.title: Compare
plan.detail: Project a few sets. Class identifies which shot followed the rules and why. Devices returned and counted.

successCriteria: My best photo is well lit and in focus.
My subject is placed off-centre using the thirds guide.
I handled the school device safely and only photographed objects.

objectives: Get my photos from the device into a document.
Resize an image using corner handles only.
Use text wrapping so text flows around the picture.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Getting photos across
plan.detail: Demo the class upload path: device to Drive folder, then Insert > Image > from Drive. Do this slowly - it is the step that goes wrong most.

plan.title: Insert and resize
plan.detail: Insert their best photo. Resize with corner handles to roughly a third of the page width.

plan.title: Text wrapping
plan.detail: Show In Line vs Square/Wrap Text. Watch the text flow around the picture. Pupils try all three options and pick the best.

plan.title: Plenary
plan.detail: Which wrap setting looked best and why? Save and log out.

successCriteria: My own photo is in my document.
The image is the right shape and a sensible size.
Text flows neatly around my picture.

objectives: Explain why we cannot use every image we find online.
Find an image on a free-to-use site.
Follow the class rule: own photo first, then free-to-use.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Whose picture is it?
plan.detail: Discussion: someone made that photo, the way you made yours. Copyright in child terms - you must ask, or use pictures people have already said yes to.

plan.title: Free-to-use sites
plan.detail: Tour Pixabay, Pexels and Unsplash. Search a topic, download one image to the class folder. Point out the licence line on each site.

plan.title: Class rule poster
plan.detail: Write the rule together: 'Own photo first. Then free-to-use. Never just any Google image.' Pupils copy it into their document as a reminder line.

plan.title: Quickfire
plan.detail: Show four images - which are okay to use? Justify each. Log out.

successCriteria: I can explain why a Google image might not be allowed.
I downloaded an image from a free-to-use site.
I can say the class image rule.

resources.label: Common Sense Education - Copyright and Fair Use

objectives: Plan a fact-file with a title and three sections.
Structure it using headings and a bulleted list.
Include one photo that I took or that is free to use.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Choose a topic
plan.detail: A country, an animal or a hobby. Topic must be narrow enough for three sections - steer pupils away from 'sport' towards 'football goalkeeping'.

plan.title: Plan on paper
plan.detail: Planning sheet: title, three section headings, what the picture will show.

plan.title: Start building
plan.detail: Type the title as Heading 1 and the three section headings as Heading 2. Add a bulleted list of at least three points in one section.

plan.title: Progress check
plan.detail: Partner check: can they see the structure at a glance? Save and log out.

successCriteria: My fact-file has a title and three section headings.
At least one section has a bulleted list.
I know which photo I am using and where it came from.

objectives: Use spellcheck without accepting every suggestion blindly.
Read my work aloud to find missing words.
Fix line spacing, margins and image alignment.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Spellcheck is a hint
plan.detail: Show a sentence where the suggestion is wrong ('their' vs 'there'). Rule: the red line tells you to look, not what to write.

plan.title: Read aloud in pairs
plan.detail: Take turns reading each other's fact-file aloud. The reader hears missing words the writer's eyes skip over.

plan.title: Tidy the layout
plan.detail: Set line spacing to 1.15, check margins are even, align images consistently (all left or all right, not random).

plan.title: Before and after
plan.detail: Project one pupil's before and after. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I checked every spellcheck suggestion before accepting it.
I found and fixed at least one error by reading aloud.
My spacing and image alignment are consistent.

objectives: Finish my fact-file to the checklist.
Add a caption to my image.
Write a sources line crediting any picture I used.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: What a source line looks like
plan.detail: Model: 'Photo: my own' or 'Photo: Pexels, free to use'. One line at the bottom in small text.

plan.title: Finish the fact-file
plan.detail: Complete all three sections, add the captioned image, add the sources line. Circulate with the checklist and give one next step per pupil.

plan.title: Checklist self-mark
plan.detail: Tick the checklist. Unticked items are homework for the revision lesson.

plan.title: Plenary
plan.detail: Two pupils share their fact-file on the projector. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My fact-file is complete with headings, a list and an image.
My image has a caption.
I credited where my picture came from.

objectives: Practise all four exam skills at speed.
Identify which skill I am weakest at.
Answer copyright questions confidently.

plan.title: Station briefing
plan.detail: Four stations, 15 minutes each, rotation on the timer.

plan.title: Station 1 - Styles and lists
plan.detail: Apply H1/H2 and both list types to an unformatted text file, against the clock.

plan.title: Station 2 - Image work
plan.detail: Insert, resize, caption and wrap an image correctly.

plan.title: Station 3 - TypingClub
plan.detail: Speed run: best accuracy in 10 minutes.

plan.title: Station 4 - Copyright quiz
plan.detail: Ten quickfire cards: can I use this image? Justify.

plan.title: Weakest link
plan.detail: Each pupil names the station they found hardest and writes it on a sticky note for the teacher. Log out.

successCriteria: I completed all four stations.
I know which skill I need to practise most.
I answered the copyright questions with a reason.

objectives: Create a one-page fact-file independently.
Use headings and a bulleted list correctly.
Include a captioned image that is my own or copyright-safe.

plan.title: Brief and rubric
plan.detail: Read the task twice. Rubric visible. Remind about the sources line - it carries marks.

plan.title: Build the document
plan.detail: Title, sections, headings, list. Silent working. Technical help only.

plan.title: Image and caption
plan.detail: Insert an image from own photos or a free-to-use site, resize, caption, add the source.

plan.title: Save and submit
plan.detail: Correct file name, saved to the assessment folder. Check the save happened before logging out.

plan.title: Close down
plan.detail: Log out, collect task cards.

activities: Correct-name save to the assessment folder
successCriteria: My fact-file fits on one page and uses heading styles.
It contains a bulleted list.
My image is captioned and copyright-safe.
I saved it with the correct name.

objectives: Choose a new topic for a longer fact-file.
Plan a title, intro, three sub-headings, images and sources.
Justify my plan to a partner.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Two pages, not one
plan.detail: Show a 2-page exemplar. Notice: an introduction, more depth per section, two images.

plan.title: Topic choice
plan.detail: New topic, different from Week 7. Use the class ideas list. Narrow it down with the teacher.

plan.title: Plan on paper
plan.detail: Full plan: title, intro sentence, three sub-headings with two facts each, two image ideas with sources.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: 30-second pitch to a partner: what is your fact-file about and why did you choose it? Collect plans.

successCriteria: My plan has a title, intro and three sub-headings.
I have two image ideas and know where they come from.
I pitched my plan clearly to a partner.

objectives: Build a two-page document from my plan.
Apply Heading 1 and Heading 2 consistently.
Insert at least two images.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Set up the document
plan.detail: Title as H1, three sub-headings as H2 before typing any body text. Structure first, content second.

plan.title: Build
plan.detail: Type the intro and section content from the plan. Insert both images with correct sizing and wrapping. Circulate with targeted support.

plan.title: Structure check
plan.detail: Use the document outline view (Docs) or navigation pane (Word) to check the headings are real styles. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My document runs to about two pages.
All headings use real styles, not manual formatting.
I have inserted at least two images.

objectives: Review a partner's fact-file against a checklist.
Act on at least three suggestions.
Add a footer with my name and the date.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Peer review
plan.detail: Swap machines. Complete the peer-review checklist on your partner's work: structure, images, spelling, sources. Write three specific suggestions.

plan.title: Act on the feedback
plan.detail: Back to your own file. Fix at least three suggested improvements. Tick them off as you go.

plan.title: Headers and footers
plan.detail: Demo Insert > Footer. Add name and date. Show that it repeats on both pages automatically.

plan.title: Plenary
plan.detail: Which suggestion improved your work most? Save and log out.

successCriteria: I gave three specific, kind suggestions.
I improved my own work in three ways.
My footer shows my name and the date on both pages.

objectives: Export my fact-file as a PDF.
Give specific feedback in a gallery walk.
Save my finished work into the term portfolio folder.

plan.title: Export to PDF
plan.detail: File > Download / Save as PDF. Explain why PDF: the layout cannot move and anyone can open it.

plan.title: Gallery walk
plan.detail: Files open on screens or printed on desks. Walk and read three fact-files, leaving two stars and a wish on sticky notes.

plan.title: Read and respond
plan.detail: Return to your own work, read the feedback, and note one thing to carry into next term.

plan.title: Portfolio save
plan.detail: PDF plus source document into the term portfolio folder, named correctly.

plan.title: Term reflection
plan.detail: Three things I can do now: styles, photos, copyright. Log out.

successCriteria: My fact-file is exported as a PDF.
I gave specific feedback on three pieces of work.
My files are in the term portfolio folder.
